segments.name: Mobile Satellite Services
segments.description: Provides voice and data satellite communications to retail, business and governmental customers, plus wholesale capacity, government and terrestrial spectrum services.
segments.evidence: The Company's only reportable segment is its MSS business.

revenueModel.text: Subscribers pay for communications services and equipment, and wholesale customers (chiefly Apple) pay fixed service fees plus expense, capital expenditure and bonus payments for satellite capacity.
revenueModel.evidence: payments to us include a fixed service fee, fees relating to certain service-related operating expenses and capital expenditures, additional fees related to expanded services, and potential bonus payments subject to satisfaction of certain licensing, service and related criteria.
